# NetworkLaplacianStability

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Stability analysis of network-coupled dynamical systems using the graph Laplacian eigenvalues to determine conditions for diffusion-induced pattern formation. Provides a mathematical tool for predicting which network topologies (e.g., degree distributions, modularity) will exhibit cooperation-enhancing instabilities.
